Certainly! Here are two hints for the given problem:

**Hint 1:** Recall that in an OLS regression, the residuals (i.e., $Y - \hat{Y}$) are orthogonal to the columns of the design matrix $\mathbb{X}$. This is a fundamental property of the least squares solution.

**Hint 2:** Consider the geometric interpretation of the OLS solution. The vector of residuals is perpendicular to the subspace spanned by the columns of $\mathbb{X}$, which includes the column $\mathbb{X}_{:,p}$.
